items.criterion: Two concurrent confirmations of one slot leave exactly one confirmed booking.
items.judgment: Yes when exactly one confirmed booking exists for that slot afterwards.
items.evidence: the booking row count for the contested slot

items.criterion: The losing caller in a contested confirmation is refused.
items.judgment: Yes when the second caller receives a conflict rather than a success.
items.evidence: the two responses from the contested confirmation

items.criterion: A repeated idempotency key creates no second booking.
items.judgment: Yes when the booking count is unchanged by the repeat.
items.evidence: the booking count around a repeated submission

items.criterion: A held slot is refused to a second holder.
items.judgment: Yes when the second hold request receives a conflict.
items.evidence: the response to a second hold on one slot

items.criterion: A held slot is refused to a booking by another caller.
items.judgment: Yes when the other caller's confirmation receives a conflict.
items.evidence: the response to a booking against a slot held by somebody else

items.criterion: Confirming against a lapsed hold is refused.
items.judgment: Yes when the confirmation receives a gone response.
items.evidence: the response to a confirmation after the hold expiry

items.criterion: The confirmation message reaches the attendee address.
items.judgment: Yes when one message addressed to the attendee is found.
items.evidence: an out-of-band read of the delivered mail

items.criterion: The confirmation subject carries the pinned prefix and the principal's name.
items.judgment: Yes when the subject matches the pinned string.
items.evidence: the delivered message's subject line

items.criterion: No other transition sends mail.
items.judgment: Yes when a hold and a withdrawal both leave the mailbox unchanged.
items.evidence: the mailbox count around a hold and a withdrawal

items.criterion: The home feed order is stored rather than derived from the index order.
items.judgment: Yes when the home sequence differs from the first eleven of the index.
items.evidence: the two stored orderings compared

items.criterion: A gallery still with no caption cannot be stored.
items.judgment: Yes when the write is refused by the datastore.
items.evidence: an out-of-band attempt to write a caption-free still

items.criterion: Withdrawing a slot that carries a confirmed booking is refused.
items.judgment: Yes when the withdrawal is refused and the booking is untouched.
items.evidence: the withdrawal response and the booking row afterwards

items.criterion: A confirmed booking survives a withdrawal attempt.
items.judgment: Yes when the booking still reads as confirmed afterwards.
items.evidence: the stored booking after the refused withdrawal

items.criterion: A visitor session is refused at every principal endpoint.
items.judgment: Yes when all three principal routes refuse the visitor token.
items.evidence: the statuses returned to a visitor session on the principal routes

items.criterion: A denied visitor write changes no row.
items.judgment: Yes when the slot and booking counts are unchanged.
items.evidence: the row counts before the denied write compared with after

items.criterion: A principal cannot act on the other principal's availability.
items.judgment: Yes when the cross-principal withdrawal is refused.
items.evidence: the response and the untouched slot row

items.criterion: The index is served in stored sort order.
items.judgment: Yes when the served order matches the stored order.
items.evidence: the served index compared with the seeded rows

items.criterion: The home feed returns eleven productions in stored home order.
items.judgment: Yes when the served sequence matches the stored home ordinals.
items.evidence: the served home feed compared with the seeded rows

items.criterion: A taken slot is absent from what availability offers.
items.judgment: Yes when the booked slot does not appear.
items.evidence: the availability listing against the seeded booking

items.criterion: A rejected confirmation leaves no partial state.
items.judgment: Yes when no orphaned hold and no extra booking remain.
items.evidence: the hold and booking rows after a refused confirmation

items.criterion: Every internal link on every public route resolves.
items.judgment: Yes when no internal link answers with an error.
items.evidence: every internal link followed from the public routes

items.criterion: Invalid form input is rejected before anything is written.
items.judgment: Yes when the row count is unchanged after the rejection.
items.evidence: the row count around an invalid submission
